name: Ragi dosa + sambar
recipe: Mix ragi flour with a little rice flour, water and salt into a thin batter; rest 15 min.
Spread thin on a hot tawa, drizzle oil, cook both sides until crisp.
Simmer toor dal with mixed vegetables and sambar powder for the sambar.
Serve hot with sambar.

name: Moong dal khichdi + curd
recipe: Rinse moong dal and rice (1:1) and pressure-cook with turmeric and salt for 3 whistles.
Temper ghee, cumin, ginger and curry leaves; stir into the khichdi.
Serve with a bowl of fresh curd.

name: Chicken curry + 2 rotis
recipe: Saute onion, ginger-garlic and tomato with spices.
Add chicken pieces and cook covered for 20 min.
Make whole-wheat rotis and serve.

name: Paneer bhurji + multigrain roti
recipe: Saute onion, tomato, capsicum and spices.
Crumble paneer in and cook 4 min.
Serve with multigrain roti.

name: Rajma + brown rice
recipe: Soak rajma overnight; pressure-cook until soft.
Simmer in onion-tomato masala for 15 min.
Serve over cooked brown rice.

name: Egg curry + 2 rotis
recipe: Hard-boil eggs; peel and lightly fry.
Make an onion-tomato gravy with spices.
Add eggs, simmer 5 min, serve with rotis.

name: Sprouts chaat bowl
recipe: Steam mixed sprouts 5 min.
Toss with onion, tomato, cucumber and lemon.
Add chaat masala and coriander.

name: Fish curry + rice
recipe: Simmer a tamarind, chilli and coconut base.
Add fish pieces; cook 8 min.
Serve with steamed rice.

name: Vegetable oats upma
recipe: Dry-roast oats; temper mustard, curry leaves and vegetables.
Add water, cook oats 4 min.
Finish with lemon.

name: Palak chole + roti
recipe: Pressure-cook soaked chickpeas.
Blend blanched spinach; cook with onion-tomato masala.
Add chickpeas, simmer 10 min; serve with roti.

name: Curd rice + pickled veg
recipe: Mash cooked rice with curd and salt.
Temper mustard, curry leaves and green chilli.
Serve with pickled vegetables.

name: Tofu stir-fry + quinoa
recipe: Cook quinoa 1:2 with water for 15 min.
Sear tofu cubes, add broccoli, capsicum, garlic and soy sauce.
Serve over quinoa.

name: 3 idlis + sambar + chutney
recipe: Steam fermented idli batter 12 min.
Prepare sambar with dal and vegetables.
Serve with coconut chutney.

name: Masoor dal + steamed veg + 1 roti
recipe: Boil masoor dal with turmeric until soft; temper with garlic and cumin.
Steam beans, carrot and broccoli 6 min.
Serve with one roti.

name: Grilled chicken salad bowl
recipe: Marinate chicken in a spice mix; grill 10 min.
Toss greens, cucumber, tomato and olive oil.
Top with sliced chicken.

name: Besan chilla + mint chutney
recipe: Whisk besan with water, onion, tomato, chilli and spices.
Cook thin pancakes on a tawa.
Serve with mint chutney.
